companyDescription: Space infrastructure + defense UAS (Edge Autonomy Stalker drones) · in the $151B Golden Dome SHIELD IDIQ pool since Jan 2026 · Q3 2026 record backlog $619.7M (+75% y/y, book-to-bill 1.73) but a ~13% revenue miss and a back-end-loaded Q4 · $488.9M cash vs ~$48M debt
priceNote: Live $6.79 (+0.15%) on Nov 18, 2026 (live-prices cache). That is -14% since the Nov 4 report ($7.90). The stock fell ~20% in the session after the Nov 4 Q3 print (revenue $109.0M vs ~$125.7M expected) despite an EPS beat, and traded $8.13 on Nov 10 before sliding with the tape. 52-week range $4.87–$26.64.
summary: Redwire's balance sheet is now strong enough to clear the survival bar outright: $488.9M cash plus a $50M undrawn revolver vs ~$48M debt. Q3 bookings drove a record $619.7M backlog (+75% y/y, book-to-bill 1.73) with gross margin up to 32.3%. The problem is conversion. Revenue missed by ~13%, the Q4 guide is back-end-loaded on deliveries, and Golden Dome SHIELD task orders are still unawarded, with continuing-resolution risk under the new Democratic Congress. Consensus is ~$14 (+106%) and H.C. Wainwright is at $22 (+224%). Base +60% is a 3–6 month horizon on Q4 delivery and first task orders. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 35–45%.

catalysts.name: Golden Dome SHIELD task-order awards
catalysts.description: RDW was selected into the $151B multi-vendor SHIELD IDIQ in Jan 2026, but no funds were obligated at award. The real catalyst is competitive task orders. H.C. Wainwright still sees initial large-scale awards as the catalyst, but timing is now exposed to continuing-resolution risk. No date announced.

catalysts.name: Q4 2026 deliveries + results
catalysts.description: Management's FY guide hangs on back-end-loaded Q4 deliveries after the Q3 revenue miss. Q4 results are expected ~early March 2027 (no date announced). Converting the $619.7M backlog into revenue is the near-term test.

risks: Execution: Q3 revenue was $109.0M vs ~$125.7M expected (~13% miss) and the FY guide now relies on back-end-loaded Q4 deliveries. A second miss would hit credibility.
Golden Dome is a ceiling, not revenue: SHIELD has a $151B shared ceiling with no funds obligated at award, so RDW must win task orders against many vendors.
Political/budget risk: the post-midterm Democratic Congress, a possible continuing resolution and Golden Dome uncertainty could delay DoD awards into mid-2027.
Dilution: an active $500M ATM program (June 2026) sits on top of earlier ATM sales, so equity issuance can cap rallies.
Extreme volatility (beta ~3): the stock has round-tripped between $4.87 and $26.64 in a year. Macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Defense small caps re-rate on award headlines rather than drifting into a date. RDW jumped ~29% the day it was named to the SHIELD pool, then de-rated as awards lagged. There is no run-up now: -14% since Nov 4.

postWin.note: RDW rose ~29% in one session on the Jan 27, 2026 SHIELD selection; RKLB gained ~10% on its largest-ever defense/launch contract (Jul 2026). A first funded task order is the comparable event.

postLose.note: RDW fell ~20% the session after its Nov 4, 2026 revenue miss; in Nov 2025 it dropped ~12% on a guidance cut tied to government contract delays.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. partnership_win sits at +7.5pp medianExcess vs +7.7pp overall (n=32) — not a laggard. The lane-wide prior governs (hitRate 6.5%, softHitRate 27.1%); macro WAIT and the revenue miss keep size at the floor.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). Below ~$5.10 the market is pricing another miss.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q4 misses the guide again or a CR pushes Golden Dome awards past mid-2027, exit.
